items.question: CJ, KJ, and AJ collect stamps.  CJ has 5 more than twice the number of stamps that KJ has, and KJ has half as many as AJ.  If the three boys have 930 stamps all together, how many stamps does AJ have?

James injured his ankle and decides to slowly start working back up to his previous running goals and then surpass them.  Before the injury, he was able to run 100 miles per week.  He wants to get up to 20% more than that total in 280 days and each week he will increase miles walked in the week by the same amount.  How many miles does he need to add per week?

Mrs. Lim milks her cows twice a day. Yesterday morning, she got 68 gallons of milk and in the evening, she got 82 gallons. This morning, she got 18 gallons fewer than she had yesterday morning. After selling some gallons of milk in the afternoon, Mrs. Lim has only 24 gallons left. How much was her revenue for the milk if each gallon costs $3.50?

There is a massive rainstorm lasting 4 days.  There is an area that collects water to prevent flooding in the area.  It ends up overflowing on the 4th day.  The area can hold the equivalent of 6 feet of rain.  It can also drain out the equivalent of 3 inches of rain per day to the nearby river without causing problems.  The first day it rained 10 inches.  The second day it rained twice that much.  On the third day, it rained 50% more than the second day.  It flooded the fourth day before getting a chance to do any of the draining.  What is the minimum amount it rained on the fourth day?

Rodney is a door-to-door salesman trying to sell home security systems. He gets a commission of $25 for each system he sells. He is canvassing a neighborhood of four streets with eight houses each. The first street gave him half the sales that the second street did, while every house on the third street turned him away and the fourth street resulted in only one sale. His total commission was $175. How many security systems did he sell on the second street?
